spec_features.spec_quote: give_up(reason) — explicit abandon action. We give the model a first-class way to stop
spec_features.evidence: agent.py _dispatch_tool: `if tool == "give_up": return f"acknowledged give_up: ...", "gave_up"`; loop honors it: `if status_change == "gave_up": tx.status = "gave_up"; ... break`. Tool is documented to the model in prompts.py _TOOLS_DOC ('give_up ... -> stop working on the task'). Dispatched AND honored as a stop.
spec_features.notes: End-to-end: schema given to model, dispatched, and breaks the loop.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: Rules: ... Use give_up only if you have concluded the task cannot be completed.

spec_features.evidence: agent.py: `for i in range(cfg.max_turns):` with loop `else: tx.status = "budget_exhausted"`. config.py:18 `max_turns: int = 15` is read by the loop and bounds it.
spec_features.notes: Cap is checked and ends the episode.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: Hard cap on assistant turns. Low for cost; high enough for a spiral to form.

spec_features.spec_quote: Termination when: task verified, give_up called, budget exhausted, or N consecutive malformed/empty model turns
spec_features.evidence: agent.py: solved -> `tx.status='solved'; break`; gave_up -> break; budget via for/else -> 'budget_exhausted'; stall: `if parse_err or not text.strip(): consecutive_stalls += 1; if consecutive_stalls >= cfg.stall_limit: tx.status='stalled'; break`. stall_limit default 3 (config.py:21) is read.
spec_features.notes: All four termination branches actually fire and break the loop.

spec_features.spec_quote: Token / output caps per turn; tool outputs truncated to max_tool_output_chars
spec_features.evidence: agent.py: `tool_result=_truncate(result, cfg.max_tool_output_chars)` with `_truncate` actually shortening strings > n. Per-turn token cap: `provider.complete(..., max_tokens=cfg.max_response_tokens, ...)` and OpenAIProvider/AnthropicProvider pass `max_tokens=max_tokens` to the API. max_tool_output_chars=4000, max_response_tokens=1024 in config.py both read.
spec_features.notes: Truncation enforced for all backends; token cap enforced for real providers.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: Tool outputs are truncated to this before being fed back to the model.

code_only_features.feature_name: subprocess timeout on rigged test execution
code_only_features.evidence: sandbox.py run_python: `subprocess.run(..., timeout=timeout)` default 20.0s, with TimeoutExpired handled returning ExecResult code 124. Bounds how long a single tool/test run can hang.
code_only_features.justification_quote: guarded subprocess execution ... so it runs anywhere
